name: curriculum-architect
description: Stage-3 pipeline skill — decomposes an analyzed topic into a sequenced set of 3–6 teachable concept atoms. Each atom names a single idea, a teaching strategy, a recommended card type, and its prerequisites, so the downstream card generator can route each atom through the right per-card skill (story-writer / quiz-maker / experiment-designer). This is the child-context-aware replacement for the legacy heuristic decomposer.
